start.welcome: Welcome! Choose an excursion or tell me what you are interested in — I will help you pick a route.
admin.home_hint: Add an excursion or open a list. New creation starts only via “Add excursion”.
admin.list_empty: No excursions in this list yet.
admin.ask_city:
Step 1 — common parameters.
Enter city_id as a Latin slug (letters a–z only, 2–32 chars).
Example: rome
admin.ask_duration: Enter duration in minutes (integer from 15 to 720).
admin.ask_price: Enter price per person in EUR (number ≥ 0). Currency is fixed: EUR.
admin.ask_languages:
Select conducted tour languages (multi-select), then tap Done.
These are tour languages, not the admin UI language.
admin.ask_source_lang:
Choose the source text language (RU / EN / IT).
You will fill the description once in this language. Not the admin UI language.
admin.translations_intro: Common parameters saved. Next — source excursion text.
admin.source_saved: Source language: {code}. Fill the text in this language.
admin.ask_route: Excursion “{title}”. {lang_block}: enter the route — 3–4 items, one per line.
admin.ask_meeting: Excursion “{title}”. {lang_block}: enter the meeting point (5–500 characters).
admin.ask_photo:
Photos are optional (0–3). Current: {count}/3.
Send a photo or album, or choose an action below.
admin.ask_edit_languages: Toggle conducted languages, then tap Done.
admin.ask_edit_photo:
Manage photos (0–3). Current: {count}/3.
Send a photo/album or open management.
admin.ask_photo_replace: Send one new photo to replace (position {n}).
admin.photo_rejected_limit: Limit is 3 photos. Extra ones were not saved.
admin.photo_manage_title: Excursion photos ({count}/3). Cover is the first one.
admin.translate_offer: Main description is ready ({code}). Prepare translations into the other two languages?
admin.translate_busy: Auto-translate is already running. Please wait.
admin.translate_unavailable: Auto-translate unavailable (AI settings). You can fill manually.
admin.translate_error: Auto-translate failed. Try later or fill manually.
admin.translate_source_changed: Source text changed. Run translation again.
admin.translate_overwrite_confirm: Confirmed or manual translations exist. Overwrite them with auto-translate?
admin.translate_done: Auto-translate ready. Review and confirm each language.
admin.hub_title: Choose the next action for excursion “{title}”.
admin.summary_missing_none: Required fields are complete and translations confirmed. You can publish.
admin.draft_saved_exit: Draft “{title}” saved. You can continue in “Drafts”.
admin.draft_save_failed: Could not confirm draft save. Entered data was not cleared — try again.
admin.pending_saved: Change saved as pending. Apply it separately.
admin.published_ok: Excursion “{title}” is published and available in the catalog.
admin.publish_confirm: Publish excursion “{title}”? It will appear in the catalog for clients and the AI.
admin.confirm_pending: Apply all pending changes to the published excursion?
admin.version_conflict: Version conflict: the excursion changed. Refresh the card.

admin.pending_exists: Apply or discard pending changes first.

admin.error.title: Title: 2–200 characters.
admin.error.photo: Send an image or choose an action on the keyboard.

admin.edit_route_intro: Current route by language. Choose a language to edit.
admin.edit_discarded: Change discarded. The record was not modified.
admin.btn.translate_en_it: Translate excursion to EN and IT

about.text:
Excursion AI helps you choose an excursion and submit a request.

The catalogue, request form, and selection assistant are available.

A request records your preferences. Seat confirmation, payment, and CRM sync are not performed yet.
about.text_ai_ready:
Excursion AI helps you choose an excursion and submit a request.

The catalogue, request form, and selection assistant are available.

A request records your preferences. Seat confirmation and payment are not performed yet.
ai.intro:
Describe what you are looking for: city, topics, duration, budget — or ask about excursions.

I will suggest options from the catalogue.
ai.cleared: The consultant dialogue has been cleared. You can ask a new question.
ai.continue_hint: You can refine your request or choose an excursion from the recommendations above.
ai.open_catalog_hint: You can open the excursion catalogue from the main menu.
ai.unavailable: The AI consultant is unavailable right now (missing settings: {missing}). The catalogue and applications still work.
ai.error.generic: Could not get a consultant reply. Try later or open the catalogue.
ai.error.auth: AI service authentication failed. Check the API key. The catalogue is available from the menu.
ai.error.rate_limit: The AI service temporarily limited requests. Try later or open the catalogue.
ai.error.timeout: The AI response timed out. Try later or open the catalogue.
ai.error.unavailable_model: The AI model is unavailable. Check OPENAI_MODEL or open the catalogue.
ai.error.user_limit: Your daily AI request limit is reached. Open the catalogue or try tomorrow.
ai.error.global_limit: The global daily AI request limit is reached. Open the catalogue or try tomorrow.
ai.error.busy: A previous request is still being processed. Please wait for the reply.
ai.error.input_too_long: The message is too long. Shorten it and send again.
ai.error.empty_input: Enter a text question about excursions.
ai.error.invalid_response: The model returned an invalid reply. Rephrase the question or open the catalogue.
catalog.title: Excursions
catalog.choose: Choose an excursion to open its card.
catalog.not_found: Excursion not found. Please return to the list.
apply.intro:
Submitting a request for “{title}”.

Enter your preferred date and contact details. Phone is optional.
apply.greeting: Glad you want to join “{title}”! I’ll ask a few questions one by one to submit your request.
apply.ask_participants: Enter the number of participants as an integer from 1 to 20.
apply.ask_name: Enter a name (2–100 characters). Cyrillic or Latin letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes are allowed.
apply.ask_phone:
Enter a phone number in international format with a country code, e.g. +391234567890.
Or tap “Skip”.
apply.edit_choose: What would you like to change?
apply.unavailable: This excursion is no longer available. Please choose another from the catalogue.
apply.price_changed: Excursion terms have changed. Review the updated card and confirm the application again.
apply.db_error: The request could not be saved. Your form data is kept — tap “Send request” to try again.
apply.stale: This form is no longer valid after the bot restart. Please start again from the catalogue.
apply.conflict: You have an unfinished application. Continue it or cancel?
apply.error.date_format: Invalid date. Use DD.MM.YYYY, for example {example}.
apply.error.date_too_early: The date must be no earlier than tomorrow ({example}).
apply.error.participants_format: Enter a whole number of participants.
apply.error.participants_range: The number of participants must be between 1 and 20.
apply.error.name_length: The name must contain 2 to 100 characters.
apply.error.name_charset: The name may contain letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes only.
apply.error.phone_format: Enter a phone number in international format with “+” and a country code, or tap “Skip”.
apply.error.menu_as_input: That is a menu item. Enter the data for this step or tap “Cancel”.
my.title: My requests
my.empty: No saved requests yet. Open the catalogue to submit a request.

error.unknown: I did not understand that. Please choose an item from the menu below.

admin.schedule.pick_excursion: Choose an excursion for the schedule:
admin.schedule.list_title: Excursion sessions. Pick one or add a new session.
admin.schedule.ask_date: Enter the session date as DD.MM.YYYY (timezone Europe/Rome):
admin.schedule.ask_time: Enter the start time as HH:MM (Europe/Rome):
admin.schedule.ask_capacity: Enter the maximum group capacity (integer greater than 0):
admin.schedule.deactivated: Session deactivated and is no longer offered to clients.
admin.schedule.linked_warning:
This session has linked applications ({count}, confirmed participants: {confirmed}). Date, time or capacity cannot be changed silently — application and CRM history are kept.

Safe options: add a new session, or deactivate this one after confirmation.
admin.schedule.error_capacity: Capacity must be an integer greater than 0.
admin.schedule.error_capacity_below: Cannot set capacity below already confirmed participants.
admin.schedule.error_duplicate: A session for this date and time already exists.
admin.schedule.wizard_intro: Add the excursion session schedule. You can set several dates and several start times on the same day.
admin.schedule.wizard_hint: Each session needs a date, start time and capacity. You can add, for example, 10:00 and 15:00 on the same day. Tap “Add another session” or “Finish schedule”. A draft can be saved without sessions; publishing requires at least one.
admin.schedule.multi_hint: Several times on the same day are stored as separate sessions. Select a session to edit or delete it.
admin.schedule.tech_error: A technical error occurred. Reference code: {error_id}. You can retry this step, go back, or cancel.
admin.schedule.input_cancelled: Session input cancelled. The schedule and excursion draft are kept.
admin.missing.schedule: At least one active session is required in the schedule
apply.ask_date_pick: Choose a session date (seats available for your group):
apply.no_sessions: No sessions with enough seats. Choose another excursion or fewer participants.
apply.no_sessions_for_date: No free sessions on the selected date.
apply.no_times_for_date: No suitable times on this date. Please pick another date.
apply.schedule_unavailable: Schedule is temporarily unavailable. We cannot confirm seat availability — try again later.
apply.session_full: Not enough seats for this session. Please choose another.
apply.use_date_buttons: Please pick a date using the buttons below.
